'''Sovereignty Dawn''' was an area of space in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] had a strong presence in this area and built an [[Sovereignty Dawn outpost|outpost]] here to support their operations.
